cases.title: AcroForm editing, saving and independent readback

steps.action: On the writable device copy of acroform.pdf, change Test Reader to LAB_FORM_20261121, clear subscribe and select Green.
Close with Android Back; pull the saved bytes and retain their hash.
Read with PyMuPDF 1.28.0 and pypdf 6.15.0; force-stop/reopen in the reader and inspect the name dialog.
On a fresh canonical copy, change only the name to LAB_FORM_REPEAT_20261121, close with Back, pull and independently inspect; reopen in the reader.

cases.expected: Durable field edits survive saving/reopening and independent readback.
cases.actual: Both saved outputs preserve intended edits, but append /Prev -1. PyMuPDF opens with repair; pypdf raises negative seek value -1. Both reader reopen screenshots retain their changes.

subchecks.actual: First run: name LAB_FORM_20261121, subscribe Off, color Green.
Values recovered from saved PDF bytes; recovery required for the malformed trailer.
First name read back exactly; all first values and second name visually retained.
Two outputs contain /Prev -1; pypdf fails and PyMuPDF reports repaired=True.
Actual tested saving route was close-triggered Android Back.

limitations: Two malformed outputs, not two complete three-field RT-16 repetitions. Rapid second-run checkbox/choice taps did not take effect; the retained repeat was text-only.
No demonstrated loss of these field values, universal reader incompatibility or exact implementation root cause.
This is an artifact-specific interoperability finding, not an authenticated official-release defect. PyMuPDF repair means recovery during open, not a rewritten file.

execution_window.basis: Host command timestamps; not pixel exposure or page-ready latency.

exclusions: Early private RT-03 denotes legacy ORANGEQUARTZ search, related to canonical RT-11; it does not exercise canonical RT-03 URI grants.
Early private RT-04 note persistence is auxiliary to canonical RT-14, not canonical RT-04 navigation. Map by actual input/action, not number.
Overlapping early note input created an additional concatenated marker; this is harness contamination, not app duplication.
Concurrent early UIAutomator exit-137 failures and overlapping navigation attempts are excluded from application-failure and clean-cycle counts.
Capture 42 has a black PNG and stale annotation XML after null-root failure; captures 41/43/45/46 without the -opengl suffix are setup dialogs, not rendering passes.
The acroform row in the early canonical-visible result still named unicode.pdf. Later form captures and independently inspected outputs supply the actual form evidence.
Capture 04/05 PNG and XML straddle onboarding transitions; no synchronized-frame or clipping-defect claim.
A Python 3.11 missing-pymupdf import and a password phase-dispatch KeyError occurred before any corresponding app command; they are host-tool failures.
The first form parser exception interrupted the script after a successful pull. Recovery preserved those bytes and resumed only unexecuted readback.
The repeat form phase could not find Green after rapid taps; screenshot 65 showed the text-only edit. The text-only save/reopen was completed separately.
Repeated shell transport interruptions during final curation do not invalidate saved app results or establish emulator termination.
limitations: One unknown-origin build in one AOSP API36 x86_64 portrait emulator; no authenticated Play-build, physical-device, ARM or 16-KiB-page validation.
No cloud sign-in, network transfer, speech engine, TalkBack task, EPUB/reflow, literal/invalid-pattern or malformed-file app execution.
Screenshots and XML trees are sequential captures, not synchronized frames. Command times are not page-ready timings.
Repository/fixture checks, copying files and offline curation do not count as application tests.
